newsitem.title: UK: Smiths in talks with France's Sextant-paper.
newsitem.headline: Smiths in talks with France's Sextant-paper.

text.p: British avionics manufacturer Smiths Industries Plc is in talks with France's Sextant Avionique aimed at forming a European alliance in aerospace components, the Financial Times reported on Thursday.
The newspaper said officials at Smiths had privately confirmed that preliminary discussions were under way.
The two companies were understood to be discussing collaborative programmes and licensing agreements, the FT said.
Smiths made clear in October that it would be open to offers to partner Sextant after privatisation of its parent Thomson SA.

Smiths' biggest avionics customer is Boeing Co while Sextant is the main supplier to Boeing's European rival Airbus Industrie. But industry executives say Sextant is in need of a partner to take it outside its home market.
